pages.title: Heat-resistant metal
pages.text: Once you've got a complete netherite spacesuit and a three-stage rocket, you're ready to set sail again—this time to Venus and Mercury. Please note that if you enter these planets without a netherite suit or fire resistance effect, you will die quickly. The next material you need to look for is heat-resistant metal.
In the extreme natural environments of Venus and Mercury, you need to find a new material - heat-resistant metal. A rocket made of heat-resistant metal could take you to another star system...
